paragraphs: Mostly because the official HTML report is broken (it relies on external js/css resources that are 403'ing) since January 2025 and no sign of activity since then on the official issue tracker: Fixed! - Android Lint HTML reports broken by code.getmdl.io 403 Forbidden error - Generated HTML output of lint references JS and CSS that are no longer available (code.getmdl.io) It also lacks proper search & filter mechanisms that can be very useful to focus on a specific scope. And finally, if we take as an example a 10k issues report: - the SARIF file is 23MB - the default HTML report is 2.3MB but…
How to create an embedded HTML report from a SARIF file?
features: 📦 Zero Dependencies: Single-file, self-contained, offline-first HTML viewer.
🔍 Advanced Filtering: Filter by severity, category, rule ID, or Regex.
💅 Modern UI: Markdown support and highlighted inline code snippets.
⚡ PWA: Installable app with native .sarif file handling.
